organization: Агенция по вписванията (Registry Agency, Ministry of Justice)
license: Free public search; CC-BY daily publications (data.egov.bg); full bulk by data-sharing agreement
record_shape: per-company entry (public search HTML / web-service JSON-XML); daily publication stream on data.egov.bg

fields.meaning: Unified Identification Code: 9 digits (13 for branches). The company id.
fields.limitations: Keep as string. VAT = 'BG' + EIK. Full per-company data needs the registered web service / agreement (single lookups free).
fields.analysis_notes: Primary key + universal join key (= VAT root).

fields.limitations: Cyrillic; many entities also have a Latin transliteration.
fields.analysis_notes: Keep both Cyrillic + Latin transliteration where available.

fields.meaning: Legal form (ЕООД, ООД, АД, ЕАД, ЕТ, СД, КД, ЮЛНЦ, ...).
fields.analysis_notes: ЕООД=single-member LLC; ООД=LLC; АД/ЕАД=JSC; ЕТ=sole trader.

fields.meaning: Status: вписано (registered/active), заличено (struck-off), в ликвидация (liquidation), в несъстоятелност (insolvency).

fields.analysis_notes: Parse settlement (населено място) + oblast (област) for municipality/region.

fields.limitations: FREE TEXT — КИД (NACE) not always coded in the register.
fields.analysis_notes: No reliable coded activity in the register; derive/classify if needed.

fields.limitations: Register capital, NOT annual accounts. BGN (EUR from 2026).

fields.analysis_notes: Directors are in the register (unlike e.g. KBO open data).

fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA (natural persons) — GDPR. Ownership of shares, not beneficial ownership.
fields.analysis_notes: Open ownership signal (capital partners); distinct from the beneficial-ownership register.

fields.limitations: On data.egov.bg this is the open CC-BY content (changes/acts per day).
fields.analysis_notes: Accumulate publications to build/maintain the master keyed on EIK.
